title: Tree Lighting Ceremony at Pioneer Courthouse Square
description: Portland's 42nd annual tree lighting: a community sing-along with Pink Martini's Thomas Lauderdale, and Santa flips the switch on the 75-foot tree.

title: Holiday Express Train Rides
description: A 45-minute ride along the Willamette behind a historic steam or diesel locomotive, with Santa aboard. Departures run through the day; buy tickets ahead for a set time and arrive 20 minutes early. Admission to the Rail Heritage Center is included.

title: ZooLights
description: More than a million lights across the zoo, with light tunnels and a lantern train ride (train and carousel tickets sold separately). Everyone needs a timed ticket bought online in advance, and it doubles as a TriMet pass that night. Most animals are not on view.

title: Christmas Festival of Lights at The Grotto
description: Lights across the Grotto's grounds, with carolers, puppet shows, and choir concerts in the chapel. Closed Christmas Day. Value nights are Mon-Thu, Nov 30-Dec 3 and Dec 7-10.
price_text: $17.95 ages 12+, $8.95 ages 3-11 (online); more at the gate

title: Peacock Lane Holiday Lights
address: SE Peacock Ln between SE Belmont and SE Stark, Portland, OR 97214
description: A whole street of decorated houses, free to stroll. Free cocoa Dec 15-24 while it lasts.

runs.note: Walk-only night: no cars on the Lane.

title: Winter Wonderland Drive-Through Lights
description: Drive the raceway through a big holiday light show from your car. Open 5-10pm Mon-Thu and 4:30-11pm Fri-Sun and Dec 16-25. No driving on Nov 29 (Bike the Lights) or Nov 30-Dec 1 (Lights & Leashes dog walks).
price_text: From about $38 per car; more on weekends and Dec 16-25

title: Holidays Around the World at Pittock Mansion
description: The mansion's 18 rooms and the Gate Lodge decorated with holiday traditions from around the world. Closed Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Year's Day; check the mansion's site for hours.

title: Christmas Ships Parade: RiverPlace to Johns Landing
description: Lit-up boats leave RiverPlace Marina and parade along the Willamette toward Johns Landing and the Fremont Bridge; watch from the waterfront. The fleet takes a couple of hours, and exact passing times depend on the weather and the river.

title: Christmas Ships Parade: RiverPlace to Milwaukie
description: Lit-up boats leave RiverPlace Marina and parade up the Willamette to Milwaukie, reaching Milwaukie Bay Park around 8pm. Exact passing times depend on the weather and the river.

title: Christmas Ships Parade: RiverPlace to St. Johns (both fleets)
description: The Willamette and Columbia fleets together, from RiverPlace Marina downriver to the St. Johns Bridge, arriving at Cathedral Park around 6:45pm.

title: Tinseltown Trolley
venue_name: Willamette Shore Trolley, Lake Oswego Depot
address: 311 N State St, Lake Oswego, OR 97034
description: A 45-minute holiday ride on the Willamette Shore Trolley with lights, carols, and a visit from the North Pole. Reserve a departure ahead; it often sells out.

title: Santa's Wonderland at Cabela's
description: Free photos with Santa: every family gets a 4x6 print and a video to share. Reserve a time online (walk-ins only if there's room). Free crafts while supplies last: Santa ornaments on weekdays through Nov 27, then sticker-by-number sheets Nov 30-Dec 18. Check the store's page for Santa's hours.

title: Bridgeport Village Holiday Parade & Celebration
description: Santa arrives in a morning parade, then the party moves to the Village Green (10-11am) for photos with Mrs. Claus and her North Pole friends, and holiday crafts.

title: Photos with Santa at Bridgeport Village
description: Visit Santa at his Gingerbread Cottage; reserve a photo time on the Bridgeport Village site. Sensory-friendly Silent Santa visits run Nov 29-Dec 13 (reserve ahead). Check the site for Santa's hours.

title: Curiosity Kids: Design and Discover
description: A bilingual (English/Spanish) hands-on engineering workshop for ages 3-5 with their grown-ups: build, test, and improve designs together. Tickets include same-day museum admission.

title: The Polar Express at OMSI's Empirical Theater
description: The holiday film on OMSI's big screen (100 minutes, captioned). Check the event page for showtimes.

title: Holiday Weekends at the Portland Japanese Garden
description: The Garden's traditional winter decorations, an origami ornament to make and take home, seasonal teas and treats at the Umami Café, and gifts wrapped in furoshiki cloth (9:30am-12:30pm). Included with Garden admission.
